class.name: NNSensorGroup
class.brief_description: Combines multiple child sensors into a single [member NNSensors.sensor_value].
class.description: Add as a child of an [NNAgent], [NNBTRoot], [NNSTRoot], or another [NNSensorGroup] to aggregate several sensors into one higher-level input for considerations, using [member evaluation_method] and optional inversion via [member invert_sensor_value].

members.member: How child sensor values are combined into [member NNSensors.sensor_value]. Defaults to [constant NoodleNodes.EVALUATION_MEAN].
If [code]true[/code], inverts the combined value ([code]1.0 - sensor_value[/code]).
